OpenIPC devourer (GNU GPL v2) is vendored in third_party/devourer for
receive-only RTL8821AU / Jaguar1 support, including TP-Link Archer T2U Plus
(2357:0120).

https://github.com/OpenIPC/devourer

libusb 1.0.27 (LGPL-2.1) is vendored in third_party/libusb and linked as a
shared library inside the APK.

https://github.com/libusb/libusb

A binary that links devourer must be distributed under GPL-2.0 and must
include corresponding source. Empty Set uses devourer only as a receive path.
Transmit and packet-injection APIs are not called.

Airspy host code (BSD) is vendored in third_party/airspy. The IQ converter
compiled with it is the MIT version from the HydraSDR tree. The newer Airspy
converter that limits redistribution to the Airspy ecosystem is not included.
Do not use the Airspy name to endorse this app.

https://github.com/airspy/airspyone_host

Airspy HF+ host code (BSD) is vendored in third_party/airspyhf. Do not use the
Airspy HF+ name to endorse this app.

https://github.com/airspy/airspyhf

HydraSDR host code (BSD) is vendored in third_party/hydrasdr. Do not use the
HydraSDR name to endorse this app.

https://github.com/hydrasdr/hydrasdr_host

osmdroid (Apache License 2.0) renders OpenStreetMap tiles in the signal-location
views. OpenStreetMap data is © OpenStreetMap contributors and is displayed with
on-map attribution.

https://github.com/osmdroid/osmdroid
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

The signal heat-cloud interaction was informed by Fieldwatch 1.1.31
(MIT License), Copyright (c) 2026 Off Grid Pete LLC. RadiusRF uses its own
location and rendering implementation.

https://github.com/OffGridPete/Fieldwatch
